title: Australian Jengor Stew
description: A hearty stew made with jengor and australian ingredients.
instructions: In the vessel, heat the hot pot over medium heat.
Add the jengor and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the australian leaves and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Add the dum pieces and cook until they start to break down, about 5 minutes.
Add enough water to cover the jengor and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional australian leaves if desired.
